svg.text: Recommended SaniCrete flooring for every zone of a food & beverage plant
Detailed and priced with the floor — not an afterthought.
Where a radius cove won't fit
Sloped and sealed to the floor
USDA compliant · 5-year no-hassle warranty · We manufacture it. We install it. We guarantee it.

a.data-cond: Heavy impact, thermal shock, constant washdowns, blood and fats, forklift traffic
a.aria-label: Kill Floor / Processing: recommended system SaniCrete STX + cove + curbs + drains
a.title: Kill Floor / Processing: recommended system SaniCrete STX + cove + curbs + drains

a.data-product: SaniCrete SL + cove + equipment curbs + drains
a.data-cond: Chemical exposure, hot water washdowns, wheeled traffic, seamless finish
a.aria-label: Wet Production / Washdown: recommended system SaniCrete SL + cove + equipment curbs + drains
a.title: Wet Production / Washdown: recommended system SaniCrete SL + cove + equipment curbs + drains

a.data-cond: Wheeled traffic, easy to clean, moderate chemical exposure
a.aria-label: Packaging / Dry Processing: recommended system SaniCrete SL or MD
a.title: Packaging / Dry Processing: recommended system SaniCrete SL or MD

a.data-cond: Thermal cycling (-40°F to 220°F), forklift traffic, moisture
a.aria-label: Cold Storage / Freezer: recommended system Polished Concrete or SaniCrete STX
a.title: Cold Storage / Freezer: recommended system Polished Concrete or SaniCrete STX

a.data-cond: Heavy forklift traffic, extreme impact, abrasion, fast turnaround
a.aria-label: Loading Dock / Receiving: recommended system SaniCrete STX + SaniCoat line striping
a.title: Loading Dock / Receiving: recommended system SaniCrete STX + SaniCoat line striping

a.data-cond: Forklift traffic, low maintenance, high light reflectivity
a.aria-label: Warehouse / Distribution: recommended system Polished Concrete
a.title: Warehouse / Distribution: recommended system Polished Concrete

a.data-cond: Traffic management, OSHA-compliant markings, pedestrian walkways
a.aria-label: Aisles / Safety Zones: recommended system SaniCoat Line Striping
a.title: Aisles / Safety Zones: recommended system SaniCoat Line Striping

a.data-cond: Concentrated acids, corrosive chemicals, containment curbs and spill control required
a.aria-label: Chemical Storage: recommended system SaniCrete SL + SaniEster + containment curbing
a.title: Chemical Storage: recommended system SaniCrete SL + SaniEster + containment curbing

a.data-cond: Chemical exposure, frequent washdowns, lab-clean requirements
a.aria-label: QA / Sanitation: recommended system SaniCrete SL
a.title: QA / Sanitation: recommended system SaniCrete SL

a.data-cond: Light traffic, moisture, aesthetics, easy to clean
a.aria-label: Locker Rooms / Welfare: recommended system SaniQuartz or SaniFlake
a.title: Locker Rooms / Welfare: recommended system SaniQuartz or SaniFlake

a.data-cond: Light traffic, aesthetics, low maintenance, cost-effective
a.aria-label: Offices / Lobbies: recommended system SaniFlake or Polished Concrete
a.title: Offices / Lobbies: recommended system SaniFlake or Polished Concrete
